load_pfm_depth_map: load a PFM format depth map file and return it as a numpy array
load_blendedmvs_camera_pose: load a BlendedMVS camera pose file and return intrinsics and cam2world transformation matrices
process_blendedmvs_scene_to_wai: process a BlendedMVS scene into WAI format by converting PFM depth maps to EXR and generating scene metadata
run_blendedmvs_conversion: run the BlendedMVS to WAI dataset conversion script using the argconf YAML configuration file
review_blendedmvs_conversion: review the BlendedMVS scene processing pipeline that symlinks images, converts depth maps, and stores WAI frame metadata
